Cognito._comment: Placeholder until Terraform provisions a real User Pool (blocked on AWS credentials -- see DEPLOY_PLAN.md §4). JwtBearer only fetches the JWKS document lazily on first token validation, and the Cognito SDK client resolves credentials lazily per call too, so these placeholders don't break a plain dotnet build/run -- it just means no request can authenticate and no user can be provisioned yet.
